edges.reason: msg.sender is used as the source address of transfer().
msg.sender is used as spender when decrementing the allowance in transferFrom.
msg.sender is passed as the owner into _approve from approve().
msg.sender flows into _transfer as the from address.
manualswap authorizes the caller by equality with _marketingAddress.
manualsend authorizes the caller by equality with _marketingAddress.
constructor assigns the entire reflection supply to _msgSender().
block.timestamp is supplied as the swap deadline, making execution time miner-influenced.
_transfer delegates final accounting to _tokenTransfer.
_tokenTransfer invokes _transferStandard.
_transferStandard takes the team/tax share via _takeTeam.
_transferStandard reflects the fee via _reflectFee.
_getValues calls _getTValues to compute token fee amounts.
_getValues calls _getRValues to compute reflection amounts.
_getRate reads supplies via _getCurrentSupply.
_transfer can trigger swapTokensForEth which makes an external call while user balances are updated afterwards.
swapTokensForEth performs an external router swap call.
The external router call could re-enter the swap path if the lock were bypassed.
_transfer sends accumulated ETH out via sendETHToFee during the transfer flow.
sendETHToFee performs a direct ETH transfer to the marketing address.
_transfer reads _maxTxAmount and _maxWalletSize for limit enforcement.
_transfer reads _swapTokensAtAmount to decide whether to auto-swap.
_transfer compares from/to against uniswapV2Pair to detect buys and sells.
_transfer checks the bots blacklist for sender and recipient.
_transfer checks preTrader when trading is not yet open.
manualswap calls swapTokensForEth on the full contract balance.
manualsend calls sendETHToFee with the whole contract ETH balance.
The require(_msgSender()==_marketingAddress) check gates manualswap.
The require(_msgSender()==_marketingAddress) check gates manualsend.
Owner-settable fee percentages feed the mul/div and subtraction arithmetic in _getTValues, which can underflow or divide incorrectly.
_transferStandard writes sender/recipient reflection balances in _rOwned.
_takeTeam credits the team fee into _rOwned of the contract.
_reflectFee reduces _rTotal by the reflected fee.
constructor stores the Uniswap router address.
constructor creates and stores the Uniswap pair address.
constructor initializes _rOwned of the deployer with _rTotal.
setFee updates the current fee state and buy/sell fee values consumed by _getTValues.
setMaxTxnAmount writes _maxTxAmount.
setMaxWalletSize writes _maxWalletSize.
setTrading writes the tradingOpen gate.
toggleSwap writes the swapEnabled flag.
allowPreTrading writes the preTrader mapping.
blockBots writes the bots blacklist mapping.
unblockBot writes the bots blacklist mapping.
setMinSwapTokensThreshold writes _swapTokensAtAmount.
The from parameter is consumed by _transfer logic.
The to parameter is consumed by _transfer logic.
The amount parameter is consumed by _transfer logic.
The takeFee local controls fee removal inside _tokenTransfer.
The contractTokenBalance local drives the swap decision in _transfer.
The bots_ array parameter is iterated inside blockBots.
The notbot parameter is written into the bots mapping by unblockBot.
The path local is passed to the router swap call inside swapTokensForEth.

normalization_plan.reason: The from parameter only carries the transfer source used inside _transfer.
The to parameter only carries the transfer destination used inside _transfer.
The amount parameter only carries the transferred value used inside _transfer.
The takeFee local only decides fee removal inside _tokenTransfer.
The contractTokenBalance local is a temporary value computed inside _transfer.
The bots_ array is only consumed by the blockBots loop.
The notbot address is only consumed by unblockBot.
The swapTokensAtAmount argument is only assigned inside setMinSwapTokensThreshold.
The maxTxAmount argument is only assigned inside setMaxTxnAmount.
The maxWalletSize argument is only assigned inside setMaxWalletSize.
The buy/sell fee arguments only feed the fee state written by setFee.
The path local is a temporary swap route used by swapTokensForEth.
